name: Missus
source:
A virus who likes to lead couples into adultery and then revealing said adultery in order to see what their reactions would be. Lately, she has been into seeing what would happen if a guy saw his little or older sister masturbating on their computer screen.

Yuuichi names Missus after the term "missus", as in wife.
